name: Vendor Name
instructions: Extract the supplier's full legal name exactly as shown in the vendor, supplier, from, remit-to, letterhead, or supplier-of-record area.

name: Vendor Tax ID
instructions: Extract the vendor's US EIN in NN-NNNNNNN format. Preserve leading zeros; do not capture a phone or account number.

name: Invoice Number
instructions: Extract the invoice or document number, including prefixes and punctuation.

name: Invoice Date
instructions: Extract the invoice issue date only, not the purchase-order, ship, or service date. Normalize it to MM/DD/YYYY.

name: PO Number
instructions: Extract the complete purchase-order reference, including its prefix and leading zeros. Watch for OCR confusion between O and 0.

name: Total Amount
instructions: Extract the final grand total payable including tax, never the subtotal or amount before tax.

name: Currency
instructions: Extract the three-letter currency code. When only a dollar sign is present, return USD.

name: Due Date
instructions: Extract the payment due date, or derive it from the invoice date and explicit payment terms. Normalize it to MM/DD/YYYY.
